description: Moves a project to priority processing. Before production is queued this is a reversible planning choice, even before a plan exists. Refresh the plan quote before confirmation. Priority may still queue; after it is queued, upgrading adds credits charged at execution and cannot be undone. The annotation therefore uses the riskier case. Call huasheng_get_project first and tell the user the current wait and fast_upgrade_cost_points before enabling it.
